It also highlights the significance of gratitude towards the divine and the understanding that all blessings come from the divine.

The name symbolizes the belief that God is not just an abstract concept but a living entity who is always present in one's life and who bestows grace upon those who seek it. Ultimately, it is a name that inspires a deep sense of faith, devotion, and gratitude towards the ultimate reality that is God.
